intro.text: Oshkosh Corporation is a global industrial technology company that designs and deploys advanced technologies to empower everyday heroes who build, serve and protect communities around the world. Across construction, firefighting, aviation, refuse collection, defense and delivery industries, we create purpose-built vehicles, equipment and integrated ecosystems that are safe, intuitive and highly productive. As an innovator and integrator, we work directly with our customers to solve real-world challenges – developing and applying breakthrough technologies in autonomy, artificial intelligence, connectivity and electrification. Through these advancements, we make some of the world’s toughest jobs safe, efficient, sustainable and connected — delivering measurable impact for the people who depend on us every day.
